name: Temporary Additional Support
description: A formula-assessed financial assistance product providing supplementary support where a client's allowable essential costs exceed their chargeable income and standard costs, subject to eligibility criteria including residency, cash assets test, and dependent child requirements.

attributes.summary: A formula-assessed financial assistance product providing supplementary support where a client's allowable essential costs exceed their chargeable income and standard costs, subject to eligibility criteria including residency, cash assets test, and dependent child requirements.
attributes.eligibility: Clients must meet residency requirements, pass a cash assets test, and have allowable costs exceeding chargeable income and standard costs. Specific circumstances include: partner unlawfully resident or here temporarily, partner overseas, full-time students, striking workers, self-employed clients, single client in residential care, refugees, protected persons or residence applicants.
attributes.payment_details: Formula-assessed based on allowable costs (accommodation, health, disability, employment, childcare, essential household items) minus chargeable income and standard costs, subject to an upper limit. Allowable cost categories include: essential household items, employment-related costs, weekly qualifying accommodation costs, health and disability costs, and childcare. Chargeable income components include: main benefit, working for families tax credits, and other income.
attributes.obligations: Clients must advise of changes in circumstances and comply with absence from New Zealand restrictions. Debt recovery applies for overpayments.
attributes.income_test: Income-tested with chargeable income components (main benefit, working for families tax credits, other income) assessed against allowable costs and standard costs.
